name: phd-ms-along-the-way-prior-masters
description: DGS 2026-10-03 (P1-deadlines-20), reversing 2026-09-27 (b): a student who already holds a master’s from another university is no longer told the along-the-way MSCSE “does not apply”. Before the OCE the row reads Not started like anyone else’s, its fact is the credits earned at Notre Dame (3 of 24 regular, 0 of 6 research — the two Spring 2027 courses are in progress and join the count once graded), and its Details say the earlier master’s does not rule the award out while the credits transferred from it do not count toward it (§4.5: “given that all the credits used to satisfy the requirements were earned at Notre Dame”).
